summary:
Bulls & Bears Ring in the New Year
As 2010 comes to a close, a broad overview of equity markets leads many to believe an economic recovery from the lows experienced in 2008 is at hand. Debate as to whether the market is a leading or lagging indicator of real economic growth aside, the positive returns in the major indices cannot be ignored. Year to date gains of 9.8% 12.8% and 16.1% in the Dow Jones Industrial Average, Standard and Poor's 500, and Nasdaq, respectively, all bear testament to a stock market continuing to rebound from the troughs of the financial crisis.
